description: Duplicate ads while keeping their social proof (likes, comments, shares) by reusing the same Page post; for regular duplication use ads_duplicate. Copies go into an existing ad set (adSetId) or into new ad sets: newAdSet and newAdSetPerAd copy the ad set given in adSetId, which must already be in the destination campaign and may be empty (it needs no ads). For a brand-new empty campaign, first put one ad set in it with no ads (for example ads_duplicate of an ad set with deepCopy:false) and pass that adSetId with newAdSet or newAdSetPerAd, so the ads and their new ad sets are created in the by-post step; the template ad set itself receives no ads. Select ads by Page post ID. Use postIds for discovery or adIds for exact selection, never both. The preview returns sourceCandidates and a pinned resolvedRequest; a post that matches several ads needs adIds, and warned runs need acknowledgeWarnings: true or useCreativeId: true. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Allowed starts the job, Approval returns status "pending_approval" with a reviewUrl and nothing is copied until it is approved in the Agent Inbox, and Off returns AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. Post-ID copies never require confirmSpend (it is accepted and ignored). reason and runTitle label the copy in the Agent Inbox and reviewId adds it to an existing review. Running it again creates the copies again. The local tool watches the job for up to 30 minutes, and a "still_running" result carries a jobId that ads_get_duplication reads until complete is true.

name.description: Name or name pattern. Ad set names support {AdName} and {Index}.

accountId.description: Meta ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Continues past the creative warnings the preview listed. Needed for warned live runs unless useCreativeId is true.

adIds.description: Ordered exact source ad IDs. Use preview.resolvedRequest to retain the reviewed selection; exclusive with postIds.

adNamePattern.description: New ad name pattern. Supports {AdName} and {Index}.

adSetId.description: Required for an existing destination ad set. Optional with newAdSet/newAdSetPerAd: omit to copy the source ad set, or provide a template in campaignId and the selected account. A source without its own budget requires a destination template when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets.

confirmSpend.description: Accepted for older clients and ignored: post-ID copies never require it.

newAdSet.description: One shared new ad set. Cannot be combined with newAdSetPerAd.

newAdSetPerAd.description: One new ad set per source ad. Cannot be combined with newAdSet; one source produces one shared clone.

postIds.description: Discover source ads by Page post ID. Multiple matches require an explicit adIds selection; exclusive with adIds.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox).

reviewId.description: Add this copy to an existing review from ads_edit_preview or an earlier duplicate, so one run is approved together.

runTitle.description: Short name for this run. If the user names the run, use their exact words. Reuse it with the same reviewId. A run the user renamed keeps their name.

useCreativeId.description: Reuse original creative IDs instead of creating post-reference creatives.

name: ads_duplicate_by_post
title: Duplicate Ads by Post
